data.headline: From Red to Green: How Trump's Iran Endgame Sparked a Wall Street Comeback
data.summary: Oil crashed 30% in a single session. Stagflation fears evaporated in real time. And a handful of company-specific stories made Monday one of the more memorable trading days of the year, for reasons both dramatic and surprisingly bullish.

data.headline: Tech Chips Lead Wall Street Rebound as Broadcom Crushes Estimates
data.summary: After Tuesday's Iran-driven sell-off, markets snapped back sharply on Wednesday, semiconductors led the charge, Moderna surged 16% on a $950M legal settlement, and Broadcom's after-hours results set a bullish tone for AI infrastructure heading into Thursday.

data.headline: Dow 50,000 is No Longer a Mirage, but the "Accounting Ghost" Haunts Tech
data.summary: Wall Street extended its record-breaking streak on Monday as the Dow Jones hit a fresh all-time high of 50,135 points. While a massive tech recovery led the charge, the day was marred by a catastrophic 55% collapse in Kyndryl and a regulatory setback for telehealth darling Hims & Hers.
